feeds.title: Yuma Sun
feeds.description: The Yuma Daily Sun was officially born on April 10, 1896, but its history is linked to the Arizona Sentinel, which was the first newspaper in this community. The Yuma Sun is Yuma's daily news source, both in print and online. Read the latest news and breaking headlines on what's happening in Yuma city and community.
